title: Taiwan puts AI chips under export licence regime
summary: Taiwan's economy ministry said exporters of advanced AI accelerators must now obtain licences before shipping abroad; analysts expect slower shipments and higher costs for overseas buyers.

title: Chip exporters in Taipei face new paperwork
summary: Taiwan's economy ministry said exporters of advanced AI accelerators must now obtain licences before shipping abroad; analysts expect slower shipments and higher costs for overseas buyers, via Bloomberg.

title: Taiwan to tighten export licensing for AI chips
summary: A Taiwanese ministry said tighter export licensing for AI chips would take effect next quarter.

title: Chipmakers prepare for licence delays
summary: Taiwanese GPU suppliers warned that licensing would add weeks to delivery and push up prices for foreign customers.
